latest_release.body:
## What changed

- Corrected the README compatibility matrix: Codex now lists `/interface-design` slash command support.
- Updated Codex usage docs to show both `/interface-design ...` and natural-language invocation.
- Updated the skill instructions so Codex treats `/interface-design`, `$interface-design`, natural language, and Claude-style legacy subcommands as equivalent action requests.
- Bumped plugin metadata to `2026.6.12.1248`.

## Validation

- `quick_validate.py` passes for the source skill.
- Plugin JSON files parse successfully.
- `git diff --check HEAD` passes.
